customApp.name: Display Name
customApp.categoryHelp: Select the most relevant category for this app. This helps with visual organization and filtering.
customApp.iconHelp: Pick an icon shown on the app card.
customApp.noPorts: No port mappings — the app won't be accessible from a browser.
customApp.portsHelp: Host ports should be in the 8600+ range. Custom apps get ports starting at {{port}}.
customApp.noVolumes: No volumes — data won't persist across restarts.
customApp.limitsHelp: Caps prevent a runaway container from starving the host. Leave blank to use the defaults (1024 MB / 1 CPU).
customApp.portUsedBy: Currently bound by: {{usedBy}}. Installation may fail.
customApp.footer: Containers are created with <c>--restart=unless-stopped</c>. Data is not persisted unless you add volume mounts above.

gpu.reinstalling: {{name}} is being reinstalled with GPU support. This page will reload shortly.
gpu.reinstallBody: This will recreate the {{name}} container with GPU support enabled. Your downloaded models will be preserved. The service will be briefly unavailable during reinstall.
gpu.amdMsg: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} is running on CPU only. Reinstalling won't fix this: the GPU{{target}} isn't on ROCm's supported list and needs a GFX version override.
gpu.noAccessAmd: Your system has an AMD GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpu.noAccessNvidia: Your system has an NVIDIA GPU, but {{name}} can't access it. AI is running on CPU only, which is significantly slower.
gpu.title: GPU Not Accessible to {{name}}
gpu.saveError: Failed to save the GFX override: {{error}}
gpu.hsaBody: ROCm ships GPU kernels for a fixed list of AMD chips. Integrated Radeon GPUs outside that list run on CPU unless ROCm treats them as a supported chip, set through HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION.
gpu.rdna2: Radeon 680M / 660M and other RDNA 2 iGPUs (gfx1031 to gfx1036): 10.3.0
gpu.hsaHelp: Saving recreates the {{name}} container with this override. Downloaded models are preserved.

v1_34.title: What's new in v1.34
v1_34.h0: Creator Packs - install curated video packs from your favorite creators and watch them fully offline.
v1_34.h1: Medication Reference - offline FDA drug-label lookup for quick, reliable medication information.
v1_34.h2: Benchmark Score v2 - a rebuilt scoring model, with live telemetry while the test runs and your score revealed at the end.
v1_34.h3: NOMAD.md - give your AI assistant standing instructions it follows in every conversation.
v1_34.h4: Knowledge Base collections - group what the assistant searches by subject, so answers stay on topic.

kbGuard.title: Confirm large AI indexing operation
kbGuard.body: Indexing this batch for the AI Assistant will use approximately <s>{{size}}</s> of disk space for embeddings, on top of the raw downloads.
kbGuard.free: That's more than 10% of your remaining free disk space ({{free}} free). Embedding can take several hours and is hard to interrupt cleanly once started.
kbGuard.manual: If you'd rather review per-item before indexing, cancel here and switch your Auto-index setting to <s>Manual</s> from the Knowledge Base panel.

linkTile.addFail: Failed to add this link. A link with that name may already exist.
linkTile.name: Name
linkTile.intro: Add a shortcut to something you already run, on this machine or anywhere else on your network. NOMAD does not manage it, it just puts a button on your dashboard.
linkTile.invalid: Enter a valid URL, for example 192.168.1.50:8080 or https://nas.local.
linkTile.outlined: Links stay outlined rather than filled whichever color you pick, so they are distinguishable from apps NOMAD manages.
